text: With the rest of the Greeks he made a peace, and dismissed them with this saying, that what could be peaceably adjusted, should; what was otherwise incurable, must be committed to the success of war, it being a thing of too great difficulty to provide for all things by treaty.
author: Plutarch
speaker: Agesilaus
translation: John Dryden et al., rev. Arthur Hugh Clough, 1864
